nodes.label: KFV Freising Touch Icon (Fire Flame)
nodes.description: iOS/Android home screen touch icon for KFV Freising. Displays a bold fire flame symbol in deep crimson/dark red on a white background. The flame shape is solid, stylized, and centered — consistent with fire department / Feuerwehr branding. Primary color matches the site's --fire-red design token (deep red, approximately #B91C1C or similar). Simple, high-contrast icon designed for small sizes on mobile home screens.

nodes.label: Fire Red Brand Color
nodes.description: Deep crimson/dark red color used in the touch icon flame, corresponding to the --fire-red CSS custom property in the site's design system. Represents fire department identity.

nodes.label: Flame Symbol
nodes.description: Stylized fire flame icon used as the primary brand symbol for KFV Freising (Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising). The flame is the universal symbol for fire departments (Feuerwehr).
